title: Concurrent TimeSample mutation can win after authority validation and before adoption
description: Fresh final timing correctness review: StratumTracker validates the caller-visible TimeSample via authority.accepts/_claim, then continues reading that same frozen-by-convention facade through option comparison, _rejection, projection, and adoption. Another thread using object.__setattr__ can mutate source_valid or other fields after the final accepts check and before use, producing a validate/use TOCTOU. Make the authority atomically consume and return a detached internal snapshot under its lock, and perform all tracker logic only on that snapshot. Add forced-barrier mutation of every security-relevant sample/evidence field before/after claim and prove rejection or authenticated original semantics.
